name: enhance-agent-instructions
description: tell Enhance what to improve, review the result, refine, and accept
resolvedBy: claude-in-chrome walk of app.salesmessage.com as the admin, on a draft test agent
intro: Enhance agent instructions | Choose what to improve, then review before you accept
outro: Thanks for watching | Questions? Reach out any time - we are happy to help
warnings:
TEST AGENT ONLY. The take ends with the enhanced text in the Instructions field, UNSAVED. It never
clicks Save or Activate. The driver closes the browser, which drops the change; the ready wait
fails fast if a refund rule was ever saved.
profile/ must hold the admin session, and SALESMSG_DEMO_AGENT_ID in .env must name a draft test agent.

Enhance calls a model: each result differs, and Recommendations may not appear at all, so the
narration names only what the chips and notes asked for. Each line is said while that result is on screen.

Rebuilt from qa 2026-10-18 (7 fail): lines now play OVER the clicks, typing and scrolls they describe
(sayOver: only the part of a line the measured actions do not cover is held), fewer scrolls, motion
under the opening lines, holds at 72ms/char (TTS measured ~65ms/char). Typing in the modal runs
~0.25s a character, so the notes are short: a long note is seconds of near-frozen picture.

steps.name: ready
steps.intent: the agent's Instructions field holding the starting version (no refund rule yet)
steps.evidence: Watched live 2026-10-18: the field is TextInput_MessageField; the editor loads in ~10s. Named "ready" so the load is off camera; fails fast if the last take's refund rule was saved.

steps.name: instructions
steps.intent: the agent's Instructions field
steps.evidence: 1 match on the config page, watched live.

steps.text: Here are this agent's instructions - the starting version, with no rules yet for age, competitors or refunds.

steps.name: enhanceOpen
steps.intent: the Enhance link above the Instructions field
steps.evidence: 1 match while the modal is closed; the modal adds a second.

steps.text: Enhance no longer rewrites them straight away. First, it asks what to improve.

steps.name: enhanceOpen
steps.intent: the Enhance link above the Instructions field
steps.evidence: 1 match while the modal is closed; the modal adds a second.

steps.name: ageChip
steps.intent: the Age restriction chip in the Enhance modal
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live.

steps.text: Nothing is generated yet. Pick any of three improvements, add a note of your own, or both.
I'll ask for all three: an age restriction, competitor mentions, and a clearer goal.

steps.name: ageChip
steps.intent: the Age restriction chip in the Enhance modal
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live.

steps.name: competitorChip
steps.intent: the Competitor mentions chip in the Enhance modal
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live; no selected-state attribute.

steps.name: goalChip
steps.intent: the Clearer goal chip in the Enhance modal
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live.

steps.text: Plus a note in my own words. Here, I'm asking for one more rule: how to handle customer complaints.

steps.name: note
steps.intent: the custom note box in the Enhance modal
steps.evidence: 1 match; placeholder "e.g., Add a rule for handling refund requests".

steps.name: modalEnhance
steps.intent: the Enhance button at the bottom of the modal's first step
steps.evidence: Scoped to the modal: the page has its own ButtonEnhance underneath.

steps.text: Enhance rewrites the instructions with exactly those changes.

steps.name: current
steps.intent: the current instructions panel on the left of the result
steps.evidence: 1st of 2 Scrollbar_View in the modal.

steps.name: resultReady
steps.intent: the Refine button, shown only once the enhanced version is ready
steps.evidence: Try again / I like it are on screen WHILE it generates; Refine appears only when done. Measured 7s and 9.3s.

steps.name: current
steps.intent: the current instructions panel on the left of the result
steps.evidence: 1st of 2 Scrollbar_View in the modal.

steps.text: The current instructions stay on the left, so you can compare.

steps.name: enhanced
steps.intent: the enhanced instructions panel on the right of the result
steps.evidence: 2nd of 2 Scrollbar_View in the modal; the additions sit far down it.

steps.text: On the right, the new version: an age check, a competitor rule, a clear main goal, and the complaints rule you asked for.

steps.name: refine
steps.intent: the Refine button under the result
steps.evidence: 1 match once the result is ready.

steps.text: Not quite right? Refine goes back a step, with your choices still in place.

steps.name: refine

steps.name: competitorChip

steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live; no selected-state attribute.

steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live; no selected-state attribute.

steps.name: note

steps.name: instructions

steps.name: saveChanges
steps.intent: the Save changes button at the top of the editor
steps.evidence: Enabled after I like it. The take only hovers it - never clicks.

steps.text: Nothing changes for your contacts until you save - review it, then save when you're ready.
